description: Given failing WCAG color pairs, return the MINIMAL color change that clears the target ratio. For each {fg,bg} pair, computes the smallest foreground adjustment (and an alternative background adjustment) that reaches AA/AAA — with the achieved ratio and direction. Feeds directly from audit_contrast's failing pairs: pass them here to get concrete passing values instead of brute-forcing colors by hand. Pure offline math.

level.description: WCAG level when targetRatio is not given per-pair. Default AA.

pairs.description: Color pairs to remediate. Each: { selector?, fg, bg, fontPx?, bold?, targetRatio? }. fontPx/bold pick the large-text threshold; targetRatio overrides the level.

name: suggest_contrast_fix
